## Reverse Periodization

Another variation of the traditional periodization model specifically designed to maximize hypertrophy is reverse periodization . As previously mentioned, the traditional linear model involves progressive reductions in training volume to account for corresponding increases in load. Considering the strong dose-response relationship between volume and hypertrophy, this seemingly is counterproductive for maximizing muscle mass in the peak phase of the macrocycle. Reverse periodization addresses this issue by placing a hypertrophy mesocycle at the end of the macrocycle so that volume is relatively high at the point at which a peak is desired.
